Mandates a one-time FTC review and congressional report concerning online safety tools for minors.
dimensions.evidence: To require the Federal Trade Commission to submit a report on industry efforts to promote online safety for minors

dimensions.assessment: Temporary study culminating in a report due not later than 3 years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 3 years after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Commission shall submit... a report

importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Federal Trade Commission to conduct a review of industry efforts regarding online safety for minors and submit a report to Congress within three years.
